Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: three short options for the 30-minute product tour

Hi Lena —

Great to meet you and Tom today. Quick recap from our discovery: your team is focused on lowering per-token cost for high-volume request paths, preserving latency under 150ms p95 for user-facing features, and keeping model output auditable for compliance. Thanks for walking through the architecture — that was helpful.

Next step: a focused 30-minute product tour where we can show inference routing, batching controls, and the cost/latency dashboards applicable to your use case. Can you pick one of these 30-minute windows (all PT)?

- Option A: Thu, May 13 — 09:30–10:00 PT
- Option B: Thu, May 13 — 16:00–16:30 PT
- Option C: Tue, May 18 — 11:00–11:30 PT

If none of these work, tell me two times that do and Ill coordinate. Please also confirm who from Stellarus will join — engineering (API owner), product (user flows), and security are helpful for this session.

Ive attached a short discovery notes summary and the product intro deck so folks can skim before the meeting.

Attachments: Discovery_Notes_Stellarus.pdf, Product-Intro-Deck-v2.pdf

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
